mentions.name: LeetPrompt
mentions.description: A platform for LeetCode-style prompt challenges where the user acts as a director for an AI that writes code: the user asks for what they need and the AI implements it. It aims to build awareness that knowing how to code is still necessary to steer AI in the right direction.
mentions.problem: People may assume AI can write code for them, but without coding knowledge they cannot steer the AI in the right direction.
mentions.source_excerpt: It is a platform for prompt challenges, in leetcode style. But you act as a director for the AI writing the code. You ask what you need and the AI implements your request.

evidence.value: It is a platform for prompt challenges, in leetcode style. But you act as a director for the AI writing the code. You ask what you need and the AI implements your request.
